title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

reports.title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

summary:
A 37-year-old Vero Beach man, Peter Solomon Ruma, was arrested and is being held on a $1 million bond after police say he created and shared AI-generated sexually explicit images of women without their consent. He allegedly took photos from social media and other online sources to make the altered images. Investigators searched his home and electronic devices on Wednesday and found evidence linking him to the creation and distribution of these images. Ruma faces eight charges tied to one female victim from June through August 2026, including three counts of creating altered sexual depictions, three counts of promoting them, one count of sexual cyber harassment, and one count of stalking.

Police have identified several additional potential victims who may not know images of them were created or shared, and they believe Ruma may have done this for years. The investigation is ongoing, and additional charges could be filed. Anyone with information is urged to contact the Vero Beach Police Department.
